checks.name: Eight-field paired NPZ and complete formal range
checks.evidence: AST inspection confirms the single producer np.savez_compressed call emits exactly row_ids, root_gt, original_prior, reference, reference_valid, scores, final_face_center, final_face_region. Analyzer requires that exact set, sequential row-offset filenames/IDs, batch size 8 with final size 4, 1189 batches and 9508 rows per stage. Scores/validity have shape [n,256], each of four box arrays [n,256,6], and GT [n,6]. Both formal stages yield 19472384 planned float64 IoU values; this is source arithmetic, not an executed recount. Holdout 6887 remains summary-only and is outside NPZ recount.

checks.name: Ground truth and expression identity
checks.evidence: Producer root_gt is batch center_label[:,0,:3] concatenated with size_gts[:,0], from the actual annotated target object in Joint3DDataset; FormalDataset is the 9508-row val path with predicted detections, not GT detections. Analyzer exactly matches NPZ GT to saved row root_box and aligns historical/current and cross-stage row_id, scan_id, target_id, root_box and point_sha256. It does not substitute a prior/reference/predicted box for GT.

checks.name: Single native score and same-query paired comparison
checks.evidence: Producer captures one frozen-parent forward and one native semantic-head call per batch and writes one scores array and one selected query shared by both arm finals. Analyzer validates per-row forward/head counters, the selected score equals the maximum native score, and each selected saved box exactly matches the NPZ slice. Keeping the actual saved query preserves producer tie behavior. Repairs/damages compare strict >0.25 and >0.5 on the same expression/query within each stage; parent selected-query changes are reported separately.

checks.name: Independent float64 IoU and GPU threshold reconciliation
checks.evidence: box_iou converts both candidate and real GT boxes to float64 and independently derives axis-aligned intersection/union for all 256 candidates in prior, reference and both finals. It reports selected threshold flips versus stored GPU IoUs, final full-256 oracle-label mismatches, all-256 coverage, available-but-unselected and no-qualified-candidate counts. Native saved GPU counts, repairs/damages and selection remain distinct from CPU recomputation. Mask values are only re-summed from stored rows; no independent raw-mask recomputation is claimed.

checks.name: Full-256 frozen-parent drift is visible
checks.evidence: Current patch retains selected query/mask/prior/reference/validity drift and adds scores/original_prior/reference/reference_valid array drift. Every initial/terminal NPZ pair exactly matches row_ids/root_gt and array shape/dtype after each stage has already passed complete-range checks. Different elements, expressions with any changed element, and maximum absolute differences cover all 256 candidates. Boolean validity is cast to float64 before subtraction. Same-stage two-arm comparisons remain separate from initial-to-trained comparisons; any reported common-input drift must limit a pure-training causal interpretation.

checks.name: Protected reference and real-checkpoint selection

Eligible candidates are only protected or formal trained terminals. Selection key is joint >=5620/4764, then strict hits, then wide hits, then protected-parent tie preference. No initial checkpoint is invented or selected.

limits: This verdict covers source correctness only. No active neural process was queried or modified, no current fit output was read, and the prepared analyzer was not imported or run.

No current terminal precision, CPU recount outcome, restore outcome, model-selection acceptance or experiment-audit PASS is supplied. Those remain dependent on actual closed collected results and the later terminal audit.
The known 5598/4848 counts are the protected historical reference expected by source, not a new face-support result. Planned counts and range arithmetic in this report are not runtime observations.
Initial-to-trained changes must be interpreted together with selected and full-256 common-parent drift. Frozen parameters do not establish bitwise identical parent outputs across separate processes.
Mask metrics are stored-row recounts; this analyzer does not independently recompute raw masks, load checkpoint weights, prove three effective contributions, or evaluate Sr/Nr.
Review is same-family and provisional; actual backend and reasoning-effort identity are unattested. No cross-family review is claimed.
